### Bible Pathway - Mar. 8, 2012
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-mar-8-2012.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 22:1
Points:
- God commanded His people to safeguard stray animals and restore lost belongings to their owners.
- Faithful stewardship means viewing all property as God's and refusing to look away when a neighbor suffers loss.
- Believers are responsible before God to show practical love and assistance even toward enemies.
- True devotion goes beyond bare legal compliance to exhibit sacrificial, Christlike compassion in everyday life.
